translated = this script's own behavior/data has a native Rust equivalent;
it does NOT mean it has been wired into a complete playable game.
partial = only the explicitly listed behavior has been translated.
pending = no claim of implementation. Exclusions are explicit, not guessed
from the presence of one networking/addon call in a mixed gameplay script.
